correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs every step from the published conjugacy, Diophantine nonresonance and preserved holomorphic two-form. Dense phase invariance gives the logarithmic two-form by Laurent uniqueness; the exterior product gives the exact volume density; invariant log-radii plus unique ergodicity give the measure classification; and bounded derivative conjugacy on each compact torus gives zero Lyapunov spectrum. No numerical or finite experiment is used.

value.rationale: The motivating paper asks whether canonical volume has positive metric entropy while the two new Herman biannuli carry positive canonical volume. The finding completely describes that portion of the canonical measure and proves its Lyapunov/Pesin contribution is zero, thereby localizing any possible positive entropy to the complement. This is a structural reduction of the paper's stated entropy problem, not a routine numerical slice.
